highlights: Architected and developed key features for a laboratory application, collaborating with global cross-functional teams.

Improving codebases and peer reviewing code changes.
Training by collaborating with teams from different time zones.
Application Architecture, Backend and UI development from scratch.
Settled up company-wide cloud (Azure) infrastructure, which resulted in seamless application hosting and employee access management.

Team handling, trained developers to have an improved development process with automation tools and implementation of DevOps.
Built applications that let users view and keep track of analytical/critical data in every step of their international laboratory processes.

Developed new solutions from scratch.
Improving system quality by identifying issues and familiar patterns, and developing standard operating procedures.
